Coral nursery (patch).wikitext:
{{Infobox Scenery |name = Coral nursery |image = [[File:Coral nursery.png|250x250px]] |release = [[19 November]] [[2025]] |update = Sailing is OUT TODAY! |members = Yes |location = [[Coral Nurseries]] |options = Inspect, Guide |examine = You can propagate coral in this nursery. |map = no |id = 58676 }} '''Coral nurseries''' are [[Farming patch]]es used to cultivate [[coral]], which are useful as ingredients for making [[potions]]. After completion of [[Troubled Tortugans]], players can access the two nurseries in the [[Coral Nurseries]], a location beneath the eastern coast of [[The Great Conch]]. Players need to wear either a [[diving apparatus]] and a [[fishbowl helmet]], or a [[Medallion of the deep]] to access the area. One [[frag]] can be placed on each nursery to start growing coral. Unlike most farming patches, coral nurseries cannot be treated with compost to reduce [[Disease (Farming)|disease]] risk or to increase yield. However, the nearby gardener [[Chet]] can be paid to protect both patches from disease, which is highly recommended. Similarly to herb patches, players may increase harvesting speed over the automatic rate by starting to harvest, waiting 2 game ticks, then clicking again. This will harvest 2 coral per animation, effectively doubling harvest rate for the nursery. The increased speed can also be achieved without any need for precise timing by spam-clicking during the first two ticks of harvesting. ==Coral nurseries== {| class="wikitable sortable lighttable align-center-2" style="width:1000px;max-width:100%" !Types !Location !Closest teleport !Map |- | *Two [[Coral nursery (patch)|coral nurseries]] |[[Coral Nurseries]]

[[Umbral coral]] |136 |159 | style="text-align: left;" | *[[Armadyl brew]] ingredient |} {{notelist|group=n}} [[Category:Farming]] ==Obtaining coral frags== *[[Elkhorn frag]]s can be obtained from looting the [[rusty chest]] ({{SCP|Thieving|33}}) on [[Dognose Island]] ({{SCP|Sailing|40}}) or [[Vatrachos Island]] ({{SCP|Sailing|46}}) and rarely from sorting [[large salvage]]. *[[Pillar frag]]s can be obtained from looting the [[tarnished chest]] ({{SCP|Thieving|54}}) on [[Shimmering Atoll]] ({{SCP|Sailing|49}}) or [[The Crown Jewel]] ({{SCP|Sailing|64}}) and very rarely from sorting [[large salvage]]. *[[Umbral frag]]s can be obtained from looting the [[reinforced chest]] ({{SCP|Thieving|76}}) on [[Ynysdail]] ({{SCP|Sailing|73}}) or [[Brittle Isle]] ({{SCP|Sailing|81}}) and rarely from sorting [[martial salvage]]. All three frags are also relatively common drops from [[aquanite]]s (requires {{SCP|Slayer|78}} and {{SCP|Sailing|73}}). ==Changes== {{Subject changes header}} {{Subject changes |date = 17 December 2025 |update = More Sailing and Interface Changes |change = * The chance of all coral variants getting diseased was reduced. * The harvest yield of all coral variants was increased. The minimum yield is now 4 at all Farming levels, increasing as the player's Farming level increases, with a decent chance of receiving over 16 at level 99. }} {{Subject changes footer}} ==Trivia== * In reality, a coral nursery is an artificial structure to form the base of a reef when propagating coral from [[frags]]. They allow for better chances at survival, and control over what species grow. They are often used with the intention of transplanting the coral elsewhere. * Unlike most "crops" that can be grown with the farming skill, [[wp:coral|coral]] are not plants, but rather colonies of identical small invertebrate animals called 'polyps', which along with many other species come together to form an ecosystem called a [[wp:coral reef|coral reef]]. ** They share the distinction of not being a plant with [[mushroom patch|mushrooms]] and [[seaweed patch|seaweed]]. *Although the player only uses one frag on a nursery to grow coral, four of the respective frag appear on the nursery when placed. {{Coral farming}} {{Farming patches}}

Spirit Tree (Farming)/Patches.wikitext:
==Spirit tree patches== {{#if:{{{main|}}}|{{main|Spirit Tree (Farming)}}|}} Unlike other trees, spirit trees are initially limited by the player's Farming level. Players can only have one planted at 83, two at 88, three at 93, and four at 96. Upon reaching 99 Farming, the restriction is removed, and players can plant unlimited spirit trees. [[Farming#Temporary_boosts|Temporary boosts]] can be used to meet these requirements. The [[Spirit tree (Construction)|spirit tree]] in a [[superior garden]] in the [[player-owned house]] does not count towards this limit.
